description: This is a Python source file defining API routes for notification handling in a FastAPI application. It provides endpoints for subscribing to notifications, streaming notifications via Server-Sent Events (SSE), publishing notifications, listing notifications, marking them as read, and guidance on SSE WebSocket usage.

methods.name: str get_user_id(x_user_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id"))
methods.description: Extracts user ID from the X-User-Id header, raising an HTTP 400 error if missing.

methods.name: str format_sse_message(notification: Notification)
methods.description: Formats a Notification object as an SSE message string.

methods.name: SubscriptionResponse subscribe_to_notifications(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: Endpoint to confirm user subscription to notifications; actual stream established via /stream endpoint.

methods.name: stream_notifications(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: Sets up an SSE stream for real-time notifications for the user.

methods.name: dict publish_notification(request: PublishNotificationRequest)
methods.description: Publishes a notification, primarily for testing or admin purposes.

methods.name: NotificationListResponse list_notifications( user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100, description="Maximum number of notifications to return"), include_read: bool = Query(True, description="Whether to include read notifications"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notifications for the user, with optional read filtering.

methods.name: None mark_notification_as_read( notification_id: str, user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), )
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read for the user.

methods.name: dict mark_all_as_read(user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id))
methods.description: Marks all notifications for the user as read.

methods.name: dict websocket_usage_guide()
methods.description: Provides instructions on how to connect to the notification SSE stream.

ctags.name: get_user_id
ctags.pattern: /^def get_user_id(x_user_id: str | None = Header(default=None, alias="X-User-Id")) -> str:$/

ctags.name: list_notifications
ctags.signature: ( user_id: str = Depends(get_user_id), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=100, description="Maximum number of notifications to return"), include_read: bool = Query(True, description="Whether to include read notifications"), )
